description: Runs a countdown delay loop, then walks a global table of three-word records until a terminator value, copying a byte into a lookup table wherever the record's condition matches. name: modulo_decrement_loop
description: Calls another routine, takes its result modulo a global value, and uses the remainder as a loop counter. Each pass calls two other routines until the counter reaches minus one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16F20
name: lookup_chain_and_fill_record
description: Scans a fixed table of 32-byte records for an unused one, following a lookup chain from a global table. When a slot is free it fills in the given values, including a timer taken as a call result modulo a global plus one, and returns a status word.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16F86

description: Fills the record at the address register with the given values, a lookup-table entry, and a timer derived from a call result modulo a global plus one. It returns one on success and minus one when the lookup entry is zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:17010
name: clear_record_return_failure
description: Zeroes the 32-bit field at offset six of the record it is given and returns minus one as its status. It makes no other changes.

description: Returns its incoming 32-bit argument unchanged, with no other work. It is a pass-through routine.

name: leave_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists for this routine. The listing shows seven instructions reached only through a handler pointer, and nothing more can be said from the evidence.

name: claim_cell_and_fill_record
description: Checks a byte cell in a global table and, if it is clear, marks it and claims the first free record in a fixed table of 32-byte records. description: Writes a marker byte into a cell reached through a second address register, then fills the record at the address register with the given values and a timer taken as a call result modulo a global plus four. It always returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:17290
name: return_argument_unchanged
description: Returns its incoming 32-bit argument unchanged, with no other work. It is a pass-through routine.

name: initialize_first_free_record
description: Searches the fixed table of 32-byte records for an unused one and, if found, clears its status field and sets its state byte to a fixed code. It copies the given byte values only when a flag in a global table is nonzero, and stores a word from a global constant.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:172C4
name: initialize_record_state_fields
description: Initializes the record at the address register by clearing its status field and setting its state byte to a fixed code. It copies the given byte values only when a flag in a global table is nonzero, then stores a word from a global constant and a global byte.

name: return_zero_status
description: Returns zero with no other work. It is a constant-return stub.

name: set_flag_for_linked_entries
description: Walks a linked list of entries that starts from a global table slot chosen by two input bytes. For each entry whose type byte is below five and whose stored byte differs from the given comparison byte, it sets a flag bit and writes a constant word, and it returns one if any entry changed.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1735A
name: overwrite_cell_if_full_nibble
description: Reads the cell indexed by the record's two bytes from a global table and, when its low nibble is fifteen and a particular bit is clear, overwrites that cell with a fixed value. The incoming data-register value is returned unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:173A8

name: process_global_table_entries
description: Walks a global table of short entries until a terminator, and for each entry that passes a mask test it follows a linked list of nodes. It rewrites nodes of one type to a new type with fixed field values, calls another routine for nodes of a second type, and changes a third type to a fourth with a constant word.

name: clear_record_flag_byte
description: Clears the byte at offset twelve of the record it is given, with no other effect and no calls.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1744C
name: iterate_handler_table
description: Walks a table of handler pointers in a global area and calls each handler through its entry, clearing two bytes in the structure at the current pointer after each call. It stops when the pointer passes the end of the table and returns its two input values unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:17500
name: leave_timed_out_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists for this routine. The listing has twelve instructions reached through a handler pointer and one direct call, and nothing about its behaviour can be confirmed from the evidence.

name: check_and_update_table_entry
description: Reads a 16-bit value from a table at a global index and, when it is nonzero and within a limit, advances the index by six. It sets a state byte to three, or to two when a second global equals eight, copies a byte and a word from a fixed table at the original index, and calls another routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:17EEC
name: run_timed_sequence_loop
description: Clears several global state variables, then runs nested loops that repeatedly call unnamed routines and wait on their results, including two long countdown delays. It sets a mode global to six or eight depending on another global and marks a completion flag, and it refers to a short text string.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1802E
name: poll_results_and_set_mode
description: Calls an unnamed routine until its result is at least one, returning early if a check fails. When polling succeeds it walks table entries through calls, sets a mode global to six or eight depending on another global, and marks a completion flag.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:180A4
name: walk_table_and_set_mode
description: Walks the global table, calling a routine for each entry until a bound is reached, then processes a second routine's results in a loop. It sets a mode global to six or eight depending on another global and marks a completion flag, returning early if any call reports failure.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:18186
name: call_then_return_stack_value
description: Calls an unnamed routine and then returns the eight-byte value passed on the stack, unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1819A
name: return_stack_value
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns the eight-byte value that was passed on the stack, unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:181C0
name: check_record_type_merge_flags
description: Reads a record's type byte and, when it is six or eight, runs a polling loop over unnamed routine calls and then ORs two saved global words with their current values. It returns one if the poll loop fails and zero otherwise.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1826E
name: normalize_three_entry_flags
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then walks three ten-byte entries in a global table. In each entry whose flag byte is nonzero it rewrites the flag to two when it was two or six and to four otherwise, then sets a global value to four.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:182C6
name: clear_flags_and_process_table
description: Walks a global table of five-word entries, zeroing each nonzero first word and calling unnamed routines for it. It then walks a second table of words, calling a routine with a bit mask for each nonzero entry and clearing the entry on a failed result, and finally negates every entry.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:182CA
name: clear_flags_and_process_table
description: Walks a global table of five-word entries, zeroing each nonzero first word and calling unnamed routines for it. It then walks a second table of words, calling a routine with a bit mask for each nonzero entry and clearing the entry on a failed result, and finally negates every entry.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:182CE
name: clear_flags_and_process_table
description: Walks a global table of five-word entries, zeroing each nonzero first word and calling unnamed routines for it. It then walks a second table of words, calling a routine with a bit mask for each nonzero entry and clearing the entry on a failed result, and finally negates every entry.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:183B6
name: toggle_entry_and_recurse
description: Looks up a word in a table indexed by a byte from the argument. If the word matches a computed value it negates the word; if the word is zero it stores the negated value and calls an unnamed routine twice, once with a bit added to the mask and once with a high flag bit set.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:18426
name: call_bit_masks_with_flag
description: Calls an unnamed routine four times with a single-bit value from one to eight, each combined with a high flag bit. When a global flag is nonzero it makes one more call with a fixed value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1842E
name: call_bit_masks_with_flag
description: Calls an unnamed routine four times with a single-bit value from one to eight, each combined with a high flag bit. When a global flag is nonzero it makes one more call with a fixed value.

name: call_twice_by_flag_state
description: Checks a global flag. When it is zero, calls an unnamed routine twice with values built from a table entry and a bit shift; otherwise it calls the same routine twice with fixed constants. It returns no value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:184F6
name: update_entry_and_linked_neighbor
description: Indexes a global table with its argument, calls an unnamed routine twice with values built from the entry's fields, and repeats both calls for a second entry if the entry's link field is nonzero. It returns its input register values unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:18ADA
name: check_flag_and_call_twice
description: If a global flag is nonzero, stores the flag plus four into one global, stores the address of another global into a second, and calls an unnamed routine twice. Otherwise it returns without effect.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:18EE4
name: initialize_interrupt_handlers
description: Stores pointers to a global area and to unnamed routines into many fixed memory locations, and sets two bytes in memory. It calls an indirect routine through a stored pointer, which the listing identifies as the Exec library's add-interrupt-server call, then writes three global values.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:190B8
name: disable_interrupt_server
description: When a global counter is positive, it sets a state global to one, calls the Exec library's remove-interrupt-server routine through an indirect pointer, and then sets the state global to fifteen. The routine's register list also includes the CIA interrupt control register and the DMA control register.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:190E4
name: set_unit_flags_by_mask
description: For each of four unit structures selected by the low bits of its argument, it writes flag and byte fields chosen by the bits of a 16-bit mask. It sets a related flag bit, sets a global update flag when one mask bit is set, and calls another routine when another mask bit is set and a status bit is present.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1922A
name: search_table_for_match
description: Walks a table of three-word entries, stopping at a zero terminator or at the first entry whose first word equals the given value. It returns with the table pointer left at that point.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1926C
name: leave_timed_out_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists for this routine. The listing has 49 instructions and is reached by a direct call from one routine and through a handler pointer, and nothing about its behaviour can be confirmed from the evidence.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1932C
name: skip_flagged_entity_updates
description: Calls another routine for a 64-bit value, then skips its loop over four records because a flag tested in the listing is set to false just before the test. Nothing is written to the records.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1942A
name: update_dma_channel_registers
description: When a pending flag is set, it clears the flag and decrements a counter, then processes four channel records. It resets their pending bytes, calls unnamed routines, and writes each record's pointer, length and period into its matching hardware register block; the listing also touches the DMA control register.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:194E2
name: write_four_channel_registers
description: Loops over four channel records, resetting each record's pending bytes and calling unnamed routines, then writes each record's pointer, length and period into a fixed hardware register block. A record whose state byte is set to its pending value updates a global mode word, and the routine returns its stacked argument unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1950E
name: chain_channel_register_updates
description: Walks four channel records, writing each record's pointer and length into its hardware register block and marking it pending. It sets a flag bit and a state code for records that were already pending, and returns the stacked value unchanged when the walk completes.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1953A
name: finish_channel_record_updates
description: Completes a four-record channel update: for each record it resets pending bytes, calls an unnamed routine, and writes the record's pointer and length into its hardware register block. It then applies pending state codes, sets a flag bit when a record is already pending, and returns its stacked argument.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1956C
name: advance_sequence_step_counter
description: Advances the step counter and index of a sequence record and adds a stored increment to a field when a flag is set. It returns a computed value, clamped to zero when it goes negative.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1960A
name: set_record_flag_bit_four
description: Sets bit two of the flag byte at offset eleven of the record it is given, with no other effect.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19612
name: interpret_record_command_stream
description: Reads command bytes from a stream attached to a record while a particular status bit is clear, and dispatches them. Values with the high bit clear set table-derived fields and a timer, while other codes set state bits or point the record at a sub-record; it then calls two unnamed routines and writes their results into the record.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1965C
name: run_record_command_stream_step
description: Decrements a countdown in the record and, when the step flag is clear and the countdown reaches zero, reloads it and reads command bytes from the record's stream. It dispatches each code the same way as its sibling routine, then calls two unnamed routines and writes their results into the record.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:196E4
name: interpret_stream_until_terminator
description: Walks a stream table and, for each sub-stream, reads command bytes until a terminator byte is reached. A command with the high bit clear sets table-derived fields and calls two unnamed routines, and the routine returns once a sub-record is finished.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:196F0
name: interpret_stream_from_pointer
description: Reads command bytes from a stream pointer chosen from a table by its argument. Commands with the high bit clear set table-derived fields and call an unnamed routine, end markers close the sub-stream, and the routine finishes by calling two unnamed routines to store a clamped result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19712
name: dispatch_stream_commands
description: Dispatches command bytes from a stream attached to the record: values with the high bit clear set table-derived fields and call an unnamed routine, while other codes set state bits or select a sub-record. When the stream ends it closes the sub-stream and stores a result from two unnamed routines.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1978C
name: process_stream_command_byte
description: Processes one command byte from a record's stream: values with the high bit clear set table-derived fields and call an unnamed routine, while other codes set state bits or select a sub-record. If the stream is exhausted it closes the sub-stream and returns.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:197A4
name: load_entry_then_read_stream
description: Copies two table-derived fields from a lookup indexed by the masked command value, then reads command bytes from the record's stream. Commands with the high bit clear set further fields and call an unnamed routine, and the routine finishes by storing a result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:197BE
name: select_sub_record_then_read
description: Points a sub-record at the stream position for the given command value, then continues reading command bytes from the stream. Commands with the high bit clear set table-derived fields and call an unnamed routine, and the routine finishes by storing a result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1980E
name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately with no work. It is an empty routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19820
name: compute_and_store_result
description: Calls an unnamed routine and subtracts a limit built from a fixed value and a record byte, clamped at zero. It stores the low byte of that result in the record, then stores the return value of a second unnamed routine in the following word.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19866
name: clear_channel_register_and_mask
description: Writes zero to the hardware register block selected by the index, which the listing places in the audio register range, and sets a global bit mask to one shifted by the low six bits of the index.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1988C
name: read_stream_with_initial_byte
description: Stores the first byte of a record's stream as a base value, then reads command bytes from the stream. Commands with the high bit clear set table-derived fields and call an unnamed routine, end markers close the sub-stream, and the routine finishes by storing a result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1989C
name: start_sub_record_stream
description: Reads a byte from the record's stream to select a sub-record, initializes that sub-record's fields and pointer, then reads command bytes from the stream. Commands with the high bit clear set table-derived fields and call an unnamed routine, and the routine finishes by storing a result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:198E6
name: start_stream_with_flag_set
description: Reads the first byte of a record's stream and sets a sub-record's status byte to a high flag value before reading command bytes. Commands with the high bit clear set table-derived fields and call an unnamed routine, and the routine finishes by storing a result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19932
name: read_stream_commands_only
description: Reads command bytes from a record's stream and dispatches them: values with the high bit clear set table-derived fields and call an unnamed routine, while other codes set state bits or select a sub-record. It finishes by storing a result when the stream ends.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19936
name: copy_uppercase_text_on_match
description: Calls three unnamed routines through library pointers and, for each candidate string, checks whether it ends with a fixed suffix from a global. On a match it copies the referenced text into a buffer converted to uppercase and counts the copies, storing the count at the end.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:199BE
name: copy_uppercase_until_done
description: Copies a source string into a buffer, converting lowercase letters to uppercase, until a zero byte is reached. It then loops over an indirect library call and a text comparison until a status is zero, stores the copy count in a global, and calls another routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:199D8
name: call_indirect_and_store
description: Calls an indirect library routine through a pointer in the base register, then restores one global from a saved copy and stores the counter value in another global. It finishes by calling an unnamed routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:199F8
name: run_library_request_sequence
description: Saves a global, sets another global to a fixed value, and makes a sequence of indirect library calls through a stored library base. When a library query returns a positive count it runs a further call, and it returns a success flag only when a status code matches a fixed value, otherwise zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19AFC
name: run_library_request_checked
description: Performs the same indirect library call sequence as its neighbouring routine, saving and restoring a global around it. It returns a success flag when a status code matches a fixed value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19B88
name: run_library_status_check
description: Queries an indirect library routine and, when the result is positive, runs a second library call and compares its status code with a fixed value. It returns a success flag, one on a match and zero otherwise, and restores a saved global.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19BB8
name: check_library_call_status
description: Calls two indirect library routines and returns a success flag, one when the first call's status equals a fixed code and zero otherwise. It restores a saved global before returning.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19C08
name: set_global_and_return_constant
description: Copies one global value into another and returns the constant one in the high register word.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19C1C
name: run_library_result_word
description: Calls indirect library routines through a stored library base, with a saved global restored around the sequence. It returns a 32-bit value built from a library result word shifted into the high half, with the low half set to one when a status code matches a fixed value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19C62
name: return_library_result_word
description: Makes two indirect library calls through a stored base and restores a saved global. It returns a 32-bit value built from the second result word, with the low half set to one when a status code matches a fixed value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19CB2
name: store_global_and_call
description: Copies a saved global into another global and calls an unnamed routine. It returns a 32-bit value whose low half is the stacked argument and whose high half is one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19CD0
name: claim_record_bit_once
description: Returns two if a bit in a global mask is already set. Otherwise it sets that bit, loops over library calls that prepare a record in a global table until a query succeeds, and returns one, also updating the record's pointer fields.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1A32A
name: copy_negated_word_blocks
description: Walks a global buffer in five-word blocks, copying seven-entry groups between fixed areas and storing the bitwise negation of the first word of each group. It is skipped when a status routine returns two, and it toggles flag bits in a global mask before and after the copy.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1A43E
name: record_two_positive_allocations
description: Calls an indirect library routine twice and, for each call that returns a positive value, stores that value in a global and a second global and calls an unnamed routine. It returns one when the second call's value is positive.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1A4BC
name: invoke_callback_and_return_value
description: Calls an indirect library routine through a stored pointer when a first global is positive, then calls it again when a second global is positive. It returns the second global's value, or the call's result when that call was made.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1A4F2
name: copy_250_bytes_forward
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then copies 250 bytes from a source offset in a global block, using an index from a register, to the start of that global block.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1A51E
name: copy_bytes_from_table
description: Walks a table in a global variable of entries holding a source offset, a destination offset and a length. For each entry it copies the stated number of bytes from the global block into the destination buffer at the input address plus its offset, stopping at a sentinel entry.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1A55A
name: increment_global_counter
description: Calls an unnamed routine, increments a global counter by one, and returns its two input register values unchanged. The listing references the file names A.SCR and POPA.SCR.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1A58E
name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately with no work. It is an empty routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:ip_intro:0:0000
name: open_library_at_entry
description: Program entry point that calls two Exec library routines, one of which opens a library by name, and stores the returned base. The listing references the graphics library name and ends in an unimplemented instruction, so control does not continue past it.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:ip_intro:0:0028
name: setup_copper_display_state
description: Disables interrupts and DMA by writing the interrupt and DMA enable registers, polls the raster position register until it clears, and fills a block of eight entries with fixed words and a pointer. It then sets the copper list pointers, restores the saved interrupt and DMA state, and calls two unnamed routines.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:ip_intro:0:014E
name: draw_text_lines_to_screen
description: Draws a block of newline-separated text into a screen buffer by looking up each character's glyph in a table and copying glyph rows. It calls unnamed routines for each line and references a mixed-case text string.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:ip_intro:0:0182
name: copy_glyph_rows_to_screen
description: Copies seven rows of glyph bytes for each character in a text line into the screen buffer at a fixed row stride, advancing to the next line when a newline is read. It stops at a zero byte at the end of the text.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:ip_intro:0:0196
name: copy_glyph_rows_until_end
description: Walks newline-separated text and copies seven rows of glyph bytes for each character into the screen buffer, advancing the destination by one row stride per line. It returns when the text reaches its zero terminator.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:ip_intro:0:019C
name: return_stack_value
description: Returns the eight-byte value passed on the stack, unchanged, with no other work.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:ip_intro:0:0562
name: scroll_table_on_counter
description: Counts down a global value and, when it reaches zero, reloads it with two and shifts a block of words down by one entry. It then copies the next table entry into the last slot and advances the table index, wrapping at a fixed mask.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 2 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: return_dos_library_status
description: Boot-block routine that calls an indirect library routine through a stored base and returns minus one when its result is zero, and zero otherwise. The listing references the dos library name.

name: leave_timed_out_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists for this routine. The listing has fifteen instructions that call two indirect library routines, and nothing more can be confirmed from the evidence.
